      title: Owner fields

      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            Optional honorific title of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR). When
            present it is prepended to the last name to form the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On create/update this is stored and returned as the
            composed, normalized address (normalized addressLine1, with a single
            space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. When present
            (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'. Normalized on
            create/update (whitespace collapsed, upper-cased, common street-type
            abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            Optional second line of the structured postal address (unit,
            suite, etc.). When present it is appended to the composed 'address'
            after a single space. Normalized like 'addressLine1'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Suite 3'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            Optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            4-digit code that is valid for the city's region via the fixed table
            (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known
            region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized by
            stripping every non-digit character and must contain exactly 10 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            Optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com

          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'

          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            Optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When present, an 'ageBand' is derived from it as of the registration date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner has the
            same last name at the same address (i.e. they share a household).
          type: boolean
          example: false

    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:

          properties:

              description: The ID of the pet owner.

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's title and last name joined by a single space (e.g.
                'DR Franklin'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the '+' and country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the city via the fixed table
                (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'
                when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the locality/region via the
                fixed table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region is not in
                the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email is
                present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>': the upper-cased first three letters
                of the city, a hyphen, the upper-cased first three letters of the last name, a
                hyphen, then a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence (one more than the owners
                already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                customerCode (non-digit characters are ignored).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                Assigned on create as '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                Stable shared identifier for owners in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                last name and postcode. Owners with the same last name and postcode carry the
                identical value automatically; a second such owner is rejected as a 409 household
                duplicate unless it opts in with 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: '1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single derived duplicate-detection key: the normalized (E.164) telephone, a
                '|', the email (lower-cased, or empty when absent), a '|', then the householdId
                (or empty). A create is rejected with 409 only when this WHOLE key equals an
                existing owner's, so two members of the same household with different telephones
                are both allowed.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.test|H-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same
                firstName and lastName, compared case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-

              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3

            membershipLevel:

              type: integer

              minimum: 1

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vets (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  first_name VARCHAR(30),
  last_name VARCHAR(30),
  INDEX(last_name)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS specialties (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(80),
  INDEX(name)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vet_specialties (
  vet_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  specialty_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (vet_id) REFERENCES vets(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (specialty_id) REFERENCES specialties(id),
  UNIQUE (vet_id,specialty_id)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS types (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(80),
  INDEX(name)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS owners (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  first_name VARCHAR(30),
  last_name VARCHAR(30),
  title VARCHAR(10),
  address VARCHAR(255),
  address_line1 VARCHAR(255),
  address_line2 VARCHAR(255),
  city VARCHAR(80),
  postcode VARCHAR(10),
  telephone VARCHAR(20),
  email VARCHAR(255),
  registration_date DATE,
  birth_date DATE,
  customer_code VARCHAR(20),
  household_id VARCHAR(40),
  namesake_count INT,
  household_size INT,
  bulk_signup_warning BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
  possible_duplicate BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE NOT NULL,
  possible_duplicate_of INT,
  INDEX(last_name)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pets (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  name VARCHAR(30),
  birth_date DATE,
  type_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  owner_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  INDEX(name),
  FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES owners(id),
  FOREIGN KEY (type_id) REFERENCES types(id)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS visits (
  id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  pet_id INT(4) UNSIGNED NOT NULL,
  visit_date DATE,
  description VARCHAR(255),
  FOREIGN KEY (pet_id) REFERENCES pets(id)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  username VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL ,
  password VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL ,
  enabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 ,
  PRIMARY KEY (username)
) engine=InnoDB;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS roles (
  id int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  username varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  role varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY uni_username_role (role,username),
  KEY fk_username_idx (username),
  CONSTRAINT fk_username FOREIGN KEY (username) REFERENCES users (username)
